The actual reader must reject every adverse producer case.
Access can fail, but every bounded source decision remains visible.
An aggregation receipt cannot claim a current model call.
Any affected validation failure disqualifies current work.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: List actual intended/current executable identities; any LLM task includes unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF.

field_principles.checkpoint_path: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.contract_complete_score: One means the exact fourteen-task contract and its adverse gate controls pass; it authorizes no science.
field_principles.contract_mutation_rows: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.contract_passed: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.contract_rows: Keep one independently compared row per exact task plus mutation and actual-gate-reader rows.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure real monotonic elapsed time; never pad a duration floor.
field_principles.execution_host: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host; old board receipts never imply current board execution.
field_principles.experiment_id: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain each field without wrapping executable scores or ordinary dictionaries.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* must identify upstream, failed check, artifact field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.gate_control_rows: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.gate_declaration_result: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_ or complete:; external absence starts blocked_ and names the check.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declare actual computation; historical model evidence is not a current invocation.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Declare the real duration class; small fixed-token runs are model_bounded_generation.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled and in-flight loads and generations.
field_principles.markdown_id_order: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.markdown_milestone: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.markdown_task_rows: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.milestone: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.model_invoked: True when any real load or generation is attempted, even if no usable answer arrives.
field_principles.passed: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.phase_spans: Disjoint stage spans, completed units, checkpoint positions and pending operations explain cost.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name input identity, availability and each failed check before work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development, evaluation and resampling seeds before outcomes.
field_principles.raw_authority_rows: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.repository_health: Keep unrelated repository failures as dated observations, separate from affected required checks.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, settings, public inputs, evaluator identity and raw evidence.
field_principles.required_checks_passed: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.rows: Every comparative unit and arm carries metrics, costs, abstentions, failures and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260915 and retain actual UTC timestamps.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed and censored units with a fixed stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact while preserving ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.science_promotion_score: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.science_readiness_score: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.science_value_score: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.sidecar_receipts: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact producers rather than similarly named older results.
field_principles.source_dispositions: Each source has URL, date, access outcome, adopted method, task mapping and limits.
field_principles.started_at_utc: This field keeps the V644 advisory contract recheckable.
field_principles.status: Publish a terminal result only after current work and affected validation.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record exact command, affected scope, exit code, duration and log hash including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished own work is partial; external absence is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True whenever the execution authority defines correctness; independent code alone does not remove circularity.
